verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is API-first. Its docs expose the file-processing operations the UI offers through API tasks: conversion, optimization, watermarking, website capture, thumbnails, merging, archiving, metadata, custom ffmpeg/imagemagick commands and AI-described processing. These are backed by official SDKs, OAuth, scoped keys, a sandbox, signed URLs, a Socket API and an MCP server. However, no source explicitly claims full UI/API parity, and account-level actions such as region settings are described as UI account settings. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API evidence for account, billing and team management, and independent hands-on corroboration.
